I am currently working on _distributional causal inference_, trying to understand how
a treatment affects an entire outcome distribution. My current work draws on _optimal
transport_ and _semiparametric efficiency theory_.

#### Manuscript under Preparation
- _A Geometric Framework for Distributional Causal Inference_, with **Dr. Kyle Schindl**
